subject: Business Models
title: Mental Health Platforms
description: A quick win: understand Mental Health Platforms.

hook.text: BetterHelp has 4 million users paying $65/week for online therapy. Mental health is now a subscription business.

buildup.text: Mental health platforms offer therapy via text, video, and AI chatbots. Access is instant, not a 3-month wait.

discovery.text: 35% of US adults under 30 use mental health apps. Stigma is declining and digital access is expanding the market.

twist.text: BetterHelp was fined for sharing user health data with advertisers. Privacy in mental health tech is a serious concern.

climax.text: Mental health platforms democratize access but must earn the trust that sensitive health data demands.

punchline.text: 4M users, $65/week. Mental health is accessible but trust is still fragile.

quiz.question: What privacy concern arose with BetterHelp?
options: Sharing user health data with advertisers

details.summary: Mental health platforms deliver therapy, coaching, and self-guided programs through digital interfaces, expanding access beyond traditional in-person sessions..
details.whyItMatters: A global mental health crisis affects over one billion people, yet fewer than 30% in most countries receive treatment..
takeaways: Digital platforms deliver therapy and mental health support at scale
Subscriptions range from self-guided apps to one-on-one therapist access
Platforms reach populations that traditional mental health services cannot

faq.question: How do mental health platforms compare to traditional therapy in effectiveness?
faq.answer: Research shows telehealth therapy is comparably effective to in-person sessions for common conditions like anxiety and depression. Self-guided apps show moderate effectiveness for mild symptoms. Platforms work best as complements to traditional care rather than replacements for severe conditions.

faq.question: What business model challenges do mental health platforms face?
faq.answer: Therapist compensation must be competitive while maintaining affordable prices. User retention is challenging because improved mental health reduces perceived need. Insurance reimbursement processes are complex. Regulatory requirements vary by state and country..
